Catalog products have fixed list prices with volume discounts available. Custom RF systems and enterprise solutions are quoted based on specifications, quantity, and delivery requirements. Contact sales for bulk pricing.

questions.q: Is there a minimum order quantity?
questions.a: Standard catalog items have no MOQ. Custom RF designs and enterprise systems typically have volume requirements based on specifications.
Enterprise RF power amplifiers, custom RF subsystems, defense applications, and specialized test equipment require quotations. These are marked 'Request Quote' in the catalog.

questions.q: How quickly will I receive a quote?
questions.a: Standard quotations are provided within 2-3 business days. Complex custom designs may require 5-7 business days for technical review and pricing.

questions.q: Can I negotiate pricing on quotes?
questions.a: Yes. Telogica works closely with enterprise customers on volume discounts, payment terms, and long-term agreements. Our sales team will discuss flexible options.

questions.q: What is the typical delivery time?

questions.q: How do I report a technical issue?
questions.a: Contact support@telogica.com with your product serial number and issue description. Our technical team will respond within 24 hours with troubleshooting steps or replacement options.
